user.title: NeoSmartBlinds hub
user.description: Point this at your NeoSmartBlinds controller. TCP on port 8839 is recommended: the HTTP path derives its deduplication hash from the microsecond clock, which is weaker than the vendor recommends and can silently drop a frame. Add your blinds afterwards from the integration options.

init.title: NeoSmartBlinds options
init.description: Add, edit or remove blinds, and tune the command timing and repeats. Choose Save changes when you are done, or close without saving to discard.

add_blind.title: Add a blind
add_blind.description: The blind code and motor code come from the NeoSmartBlinds app. Every bf motor blind must carry its motor code (usually bf). Set close time to the real measured full travel, timed with a stopwatch.

tuning.title: Command timing and repeats
tuning.description: These control how commands are spaced and repeated. If the blinds appear to move on their own (flapping), the repeats are the first thing to look at: they re-send a drive after the blind is at rest, so a repeat that lands too late re-drives it. Keep the repeats inside a single travel, or set the count to 0 to switch them off while diagnosing. Never set the command backoff below 0.5 seconds, the hub needs that long to process each frame.

data.favourite_idle_guard: Favourite idle guard, seconds a blind must be stopped before gp
data.favourite_settle_timeout: Favourite settle timeout, seconds to wait for a moving blind before gp
data.log_commands: Log every transmitted command at info level

set_favourite.name: Set favourite
set_favourite.description: Send the blind to its single stored favourite position (gp), waiting for it to be stationary first.

send_command.name: Send raw command
send_command.description: Send a raw motor command straight to the blind, for troubleshooting.
